spans.s:
निघ नि-घ, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. हन् with नि),
as high as broad; (anything) whose height and cir-
cumference are equal; a round or circle, a ball; sin.
—निघानिघ (˚घ-अन्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, of different
forms or sizes.

निघण्ट नि-घण्ट (said to be fr. rt. गम्
or हन् or हृ with नि; gender doubtful), a word;
a glossary or collection of words or names, (in this
sense properly pl.); often the collection of Vedic words
explained in the Nirukta, see नि-घण्टु below.

नि-घण्टि, probably only a wrong form for नि-
घण्ट or नि-घण्टु.

नि-घण्टिका, f. a species of bulbous plant (=
गुलञ्च-कन्द).

नि-घण्टु, उस्, m. (or नि-घण्टुक), any vocabu-
lary or collection of words or names, but especially a
N. of the Vedic glossary explained by Yāska in his
Nirukta, (in this sense usually pl. निघण्टवस् as
embracing five chapters.)
—निघण्टु-भाष्य, अम्,
n. ‘commentary on part of the Nighaṇṭus,’ N. of a
work by Deva-rāja on the three chapters of synonyms
incompletely treated by Yāska.
—निघण्टु-राज,
अस्, m. ‘king of glossaries,’ N. of a medical lexicon
commonly called Abhidhāna-cūḍā-maṇi.
निघर्ष नि-घर्ष. See नि-घृष् below.

नि-घर्ष, अस्, m. rubbing, friction, pounding,
crushing.

निघस नि-घस, अस्, m. (fr. rt. घस् with
नि), eating; food, victuals.

निघात नि-घात, अस्, m. (fr. the Caus. of
rt. हन् with नि), a blow, stroke; suppression of
accent, absence of accent.
नि-घातम्, ind. having struck.
नि-घाति, इस्, f. an iron club or mace or hammer (?).

नि-घातिन्, ई, इनी, इ, striking down, killing, de-
stroying.

निघुष् नि-घुष् (rt. 2. घुष् = घृष् with
नि), Caus. P. -घोषयति, -यितुम्, to tread down,
trample under foot, crush, pound, grind.

निघुष्ट नि-घुष्ट, अम्, n. (fr. rt. 1. घुष्
with नि), sound, noise.

नि-घर्षण, अम्, n. rubbing, friction, grinding,
trituration; [cf. निर्-घर्षण.]

नि-घृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, rubbed, ground; chafed,
worn, grazed, abraded, excoriated; subdued.

नि-घृष्व, अस्, आ, अम्, rubbed off, abraded,
excoriated; small, insignificant; (अस्), m. a hoof;
wind; an ass or a mule; a boar; a road; (अम्), n.
the mark of a hoof (?).

निघ्न नि-घ्न, अस्, आ, अम्, (fr. नि-हन्), depend-
ant, subservient, docile; dependant on a substantive
[]
(as an adjective); (after a numeral) multiplied with;
(अस्), m., N. of a son of An-araṇya and father of An-
amitra; of a son of An-amitra.
निघ्न-क, अस्, आ, अम्, = नि-घ्न, dependant.

नि-घ्नत्, अन्, अती, अत्, smiting, slaying, killing,
destroying, overcoming.
नि-घ्नान, अस्, आ, अम्, slaying, killing.
